statement: On an AboveAnchor prefix, successive odd-run starts x_i satisfy x_{i+2} < x_i. False. Sources are maximal odd-run starts, so NextOddSource is the existing Q-landing when Q is odd. The 37-chain is 37, 9317, 2233 with 2233 > 37; 3375 is interior to the first run. The leftover 365-chain 365, 763, 1749, 4447, 12707 is strictly increasing. A cube-odd triple also fails: n=321, 225539 -> 5958969 -> 520655. This is not a new source map, not a Z5 family, and not a halt theorem.
